body.message:
Here are the key conditions for the 2BR in Elite Business Bay:

Minimum stay is 3 months, extendable in 3-month blocks. For 6 months, the rate locks in for the first 3 months and gets confirmed closer to renewal for the second block. To secure the unit it's first month + last month upfront, plus a fully refundable AED 2,000 damage deposit returned within 14 working days after check-out. Check-in is 3pm, check-out 12 noon, no smoking or parties.

Would you like to come see it first?
